verdict.rationale: Agent-readable docs are a fair question for a SaaS product with a public developer API, so the axis applies. However, the probe found no llms.txt (HTTP 404 at developers.google.com/llms.txt), and nothing in the evidence describes agent-oriented documentation. The API discovery document and the AI-agent add-on guide are adjacent material (a machine-readable API spec and a guide to building agents), not docs aimed at agents, so they earn no credit.
